mentions.name: datachannel-clj
mentions.description: This library is a pure Clojure implementation of WebRTC Data Channels (SCTP over DTLS over UDP), providing a minimal, dependency-free (aside from Clojure itself) way to establish peer-to-peer data channels on the JVM.
mentions.problem: The author had always wanted a dependency-free way to establish WebRTC data channels in Clojure on the JVM.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a pure Clojure implementation of WebRTC Data Channels (SCTP over DTLS over UDP). The library provides a minimal, dependency-free (except for Clojure itself) way to establish peer-to-peer data channels on the JVM.
